title: Design and evaluation of AI copilots – case studies of retail copilot templates
reasoning: The paper places 'Responsible AI' (RAI) as a central component of its design and evaluation framework. It includes dedicated sections on 'Responsible AI guardrails' and 'Managing unintended consequences,' which detail the mitigation of harms such as biased outputs, inequitable responses, and unethical behavior, treating these considerations as fundamental business requirements rather than a peripheral ethical statement.
